propositions: The reconciler's .bridge_state cache consumes 92% of the tickets branch (950 MiB of 1.04 GiB) due to scattered edits defeating git delta compression across an 18 MB bindings.json file.
Fields baseline_advanced_at (1144 entries per pass) and last_get_pass (20 entries per pass) are written frequently but baseline itself (the value) never changes, causing unnecessary churn.

Deleting baseline_advanced_at reduces marginal packed cost from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB per version (7.4x improvement); moving last_get_pass to a sidecar achieves 12.8x total improvement by halving version count.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import shrinks existing history from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges, with HEAD tree byte-identical after dynamic re-add.
Post-reclaim writer clones must refuse stale-epoch state at union and push sites; rollback requires operator-controlled ref restoration, writer re-cloning, and fail-closed epoch mismatch guards.
